parameters.title: The row's words.
parameters.subtitle: A supporting line under the title.
parameters.leading: A glyph at the start, 20 px.
parameters.trailing: A control at the end (a switch, a checkbox).
parameters.trailingText: A value at the end, muted.
parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.selected: Whether the row is latched down as the current choice.
parameters.showChevron: Controls the directional indicator at the end of the row.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Applies the destructive treatment to the row.
parameters.semanticLabel: The row's name for a screen reader, in place of its words.
